cards.buyer: New or recently upgraded US RV owner
cards.purchase_reason: Keep maintenance, warranty, recall, and resale records together
cards.specific_task: Turn manuals, service visits, receipts, and recall checks into a usable evidence trail
cards.unmet_scenario: Low-content logs are too blank, too small, or provide too little guidance for warranty and resale documentation
cards.format_reason: A durable write-in record can stay with vehicle documents and be used during service
cards.discovery_query_or_channel: RV maintenance log book; RV maintenance record book

observations.observation: Recent buyers describe purchasing a physical log for a new RV, warranty records, and future resale; one says it is mostly blank and lacks enough pages or tips
observations.interpretation: The write-in book job is real and guidance depth is a concrete gap
observations.alternative_explanation: Reviews are syndicated by a reseller and may overrepresent one title

observations.observation: An RV owner explicitly asks which current maintenance book to buy and another reports buying a manual after comparing reviews and videos
observations.interpretation: RV owners deliberately buy printed maintenance references
observations.alternative_explanation: The request is for repair instruction, not a record system

observations.observation: Free templates and dedicated apps cover logging, reminders, components, and service history
observations.interpretation: A paid book must add extraction, evidence, and handoff workflow rather than blank forms
observations.alternative_explanation: Digital tools may eliminate the need for a book

source_independence.rationale: Distinct buyer-review cluster, community request, and current digital alternatives

production_constraints: Use owner manuals and service professionals as controlling sources
cards.main_uncertainty: Whether the guided system can earn a premium over $6.99 low-content logs

cards.buyer: Advanced-beginner garment sewer fitting clothes on their own body
cards.purchase_reason: Diagnose fit problems without an in-person fitter
cards.specific_task: Read wrinkles and balance lines, choose an adjustment order, and record successive muslins
cards.unmet_scenario: Authoritative fitting books can feel overwhelming and often assume a second person is fitting the garment
cards.format_reason: Readers explicitly prefer a physical reference beside the sewing table; visual diagnosis and iteration notes benefit from print
cards.discovery_query_or_channel: beginner garment fitting book; self fitting sewing book

observations.observation: A buyer says one fitting book was overwhelming, puts alternatives on library hold, and states this information clicks better in a physical book
observations.interpretation: Physical-book preference and the overwhelm gap are directly stated
observations.alternative_explanation: Library borrowing may be preferred over buying

observations.observation: Readers describe buying or keeping the 224-page photo guide as a reference; several note beginner value
observations.interpretation: The reference-book job has durable purchase evidence
observations.alternative_explanation: The incumbent may already satisfy the need

observations.observation: Independent reviews say the book targets serious sewists and its method fits a garment on another person
observations.interpretation: A bounded self-fitting workflow may be an accessible scenario gap
observations.alternative_explanation: The technical method may inherently require a helper

source_independence.rationale: Current buyer request, reader reviews, and independent specialist review

production_constraints: Do not reproduce competitor diagnostic sequences
cards.main_uncertainty: Whether a safe self-fitting simplification is technically valid without expert authorship

cards.buyer: UK resident newly assigned an allotment
cards.purchase_reason: Avoid being overwhelmed during the first growing year
cards.specific_task: Turn an empty or neglected plot into a manageable first-season plan
cards.unmet_scenario: Comprehensive 224-352 page guides are useful but can be busy; beginners ask for a simple hold-my-hand sequence
cards.format_reason: Buyers keep month-by-month books at hand and use charts or plans at the plot
cards.discovery_query_or_channel: first allotment book UK; allotment month by month

observations.observation: RHS maintains a £14.99 paperback handbook/planner in its specialist catalogue
observations.interpretation: A credible specialist publisher sustains the format
observations.alternative_explanation: Catalogue presence alone does not prove current sales

observations.observation: A new allotment holder is told the month-by-month book is needed at hand rather than repeatedly borrowed
observations.interpretation: The physical reference job is explicit
observations.alternative_explanation: One recommendation may reflect incumbent brand familiarity

observations.observation: A first-plot buyer asks for planning help and describes an existing planting guide as overwhelming and busy
observations.interpretation: Simplicity is a specific gap
observations.alternative_explanation: Established alternatives may already offer simpler formats

source_independence.rationale: Specialist publisher plus two separate buyer discussions

cards.main_uncertainty: Whether simplicity is enough to beat trusted RHS and bestselling incumbents
cards.concept: Your First Allotment Year: A Low-Overwhelm UK Field Planner

cards.buyer: US CDL candidate approaching the pre-trip skills test
cards.purchase_reason: Memorize and speak the inspection sequence under pressure
cards.specific_task: Rehearse state-specific component checks aloud in a stable route
cards.unmet_scenario: Candidates get tongue-tied and want a full non-modernized or state-specific oral rehearsal tool
cards.format_reason: A partner can hold the book while the candidate walks around a vehicle and recites
cards.discovery_query_or_channel: CDL pre trip study guide plus state name

observations.observation: A candidate says repeated reading and videos still leave them tongue-tied on the engine section
observations.interpretation: Oral retrieval, not information access, is the job
observations.alternative_explanation: Hands-on practice or audio may outperform print

observations.observation: A commenter strongly recommends a downloaded pre-trip guide with pictures and required wording
observations.interpretation: Candidates use structured guides in addition to official manuals
observations.alternative_explanation: The purchased/downloaded status and seller independence are not fully observable

observations.observation: A student with one week left asks for a full non-modernized pre-trip study tool
observations.interpretation: A bounded rehearsal format is requested
observations.alternative_explanation: The strongest alternatives are free video and vehicle practice

cards.main_uncertainty: Whether print adds enough value over free video and hands-on school practice
cards.concept: State-Specific CDL Pre-Trip Oral Rehearsal Book

cards.buyer: Beginning family historian who wants defensible research notes
cards.purchase_reason: Avoid losing source context and repeating research
cards.specific_task: Evaluate a source, capture citation elements, and connect claims to evidence
cards.unmet_scenario: Generic family-tree workbooks collect names but do not teach source evaluation and layered citations
cards.format_reason: Researchers use workbooks and desk-side cheat sheets while handling records
cards.discovery_query_or_channel: genealogy source citation workbook; source evaluation workbook

observations.observation: A family-tree workbook has 27 ratings and reviewers describe using it with a companion guide
observations.interpretation: The workbook-plus-guidance architecture is purchased
observations.alternative_explanation: Some reviews were advance copies

observations.observation: A specialist store sells an eight-page genealogy citation cheat sheet for $9.99
observations.interpretation: Buyers pay for compact help with this exact job
observations.alternative_explanation: Store reputation and digital delivery may not transfer to KDP

observations.observation: A specialist sells a source-evaluation PDF workbook focused on extracting clues and judging evidence
observations.interpretation: Source evaluation supports a workbook product
observations.alternative_explanation: The existing product may already cover the accessible gap

source_independence.rationale: Reader-review platform and two separate specialist sellers

cards.main_uncertainty: Whether a newcomer can establish trust against specialist authorities

cards.buyer: New birder who wants a physical field reference
cards.purchase_reason: Identify local birds without relying only on an app
cards.specific_task: Narrow likely birds quickly in the field
cards.unmet_scenario: National guides are too broad; local compact guides may omit migrants
cards.format_reason: Buyer explicitly prefers books in the field and values compact color organization
cards.discovery_query_or_channel: beginner bird field guide plus state

observations.observation: A buyer prefers books over apps and praises a compact color-organized state guide while noting missing migratory birds
observations.interpretation: The format and gap are directly described
observations.alternative_explanation: A single incumbent-specific comment does not establish an accessible market gap

source_independence.rationale: Two independent origins would be required; only one was retained

production_constraints: Large original or licensed image set

cards.purchase_reason: Learn changed everyday workflows after upgrading
cards.specific_task: Complete common tasks in the new OS
cards.unmet_scenario: No observed gap beyond generic large-print instruction
cards.format_reason: Prior-version senior guides exist, but purchase preference is unobserved

observations.observation: Apple released macOS 27 beta 8
observations.interpretation: A technology transition is real
observations.alternative_explanation: Documentation and video may dominate; a release does not prove book demand

observations.observation: A 185-page macOS 26 senior guide is listed at $5.99 as an eBook
observations.interpretation: The category has supply
observations.alternative_explanation: A listing is not evidence of purchase or an accessible gap

source_independence.rationale: Vendor event and independent listing are separate but do not support purchases

cards.buyer: Rugby fan considering travel to Australia in 2027
cards.purchase_reason: Follow the tournament and navigate venues
cards.unmet_scenario: No current evidence that an unofficial travel workbook is preferred over official guides and travel packages
cards.format_reason: Verified buyers used the 2023 official guide to follow the tournament

observations.observation: Verified buyers rated a €13.90 official 128-page guide useful for following the 2023 tournament
observations.interpretation: Comparable event-book purchases occurred
observations.alternative_explanation: Demand may depend on official licensing and team photography

observations.observation: World Rugby confirms Australia 2027 runs 1 October to 13 November
observations.interpretation: The future event and planning window are real
observations.alternative_explanation: Official products and free travel content may capture demand

source_independence.rationale: Retail buyer reviews and event organizer are independent

cards.main_uncertainty: Accessible gap for an unofficial book

cards.buyer: New home espresso owner dialing in beans
cards.purchase_reason: Stop repeating failed shots and know what to change next
cards.specific_task: Record dose, grind, yield, time, taste, and next adjustment
cards.unmet_scenario: Existing tasting logs do not guide the next adjustment
cards.format_reason: A kitchen-side write-in log is plausible but not evidenced as a purchase preference

observations.observation: A new owner says existing logbooks capture tasting notes rather than dialing-in variables or next steps
observations.interpretation: The scenario gap is specific
observations.alternative_explanation: The person was building a free community resource, not asking to buy a book

observations.observation: A user logs shots in an app while community guides answer technique questions
observations.interpretation: The strongest substitute may be digital
observations.alternative_explanation: Some buyers may still prefer paper

source_independence.rationale: Separate community discussions, but neither proves a book purchase

production_constraints: Coffee variables differ by machine and grinder
